pages.title: BEYBLADES Beyblade X Xtreme Battle Set - Multi
pages.description: Get ready to battle with the Beyblade X Xtreme Battle Set, filled with all you need to begin your quest for Beymastery. The Xtreme Beystadium and 2 Beyblade X right-spin tops feature the X-Celerator Gear System to level up your game. When the gear of the top engages the stadiums X-Celerator Rail, it can super-accelerate into an Xtreme Dash rocketing it around the arena for crushing collisions. Use the 2 launchers to unleash the Dagger Dran 4-60R Attack Type and Tusk Mammoth 3-60T Balance Type tops, score points with each clash and first to 4 points wins.
